title: Too lightweight
text: Too lightweight. I got this step ladder because it said lightweight, but it is TOO lightweight.  I have to have someone hold it for me or I tip right over when standing on it.  The height is good and the gold is more interesting than the usual metal color.  So, if you have someone handy to spot you when using it, it's a good buy.

product_metadata.title: Lightweight Aluminum 4 Step Ladder Folding Step Stool Stepladders with Anti-Slip Wide Pedal Space Saving and Sturdy for Home and Kitchen Use (Black&Silver)
features: Beautiful Color & Stylish Design – With modern design, our foldable stepladder stool can fit in your house like a furniture. The step ladder is easy to fold up and unfold, can put it in your closet when not use, it good for kitchen, bedroom, library, classroom to use.

Stability & Strong Structure - The ladder shelf built from ultra lightweight yet strong, sturdy and durable aluminum frame and coated with black&silver color, we are sure the decorative ladder will meet your needs. The ladder for bookshelf is durable and lightweight, supports a maximum load capacity of 330 lbs.

Lightweight & Space-Saving - Unfolded: 56.3"H X 29.5"L X 21.1"W, Folded: 59''H X 21.1"L X 2.16"W, Net Weight: 9.5 pounds, it comes fully assembled! Easy folding design for convenient storage and transportation.
